usedFor: Groove holds support tickets, and Google Docs receives their text through “Add or Replace Text In Tab” as tickets change.

bestTemplate.name: “Ticket Closed” in Groove, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A closed ticket is finished, so its outcome can be written into a document tab.

watchOut: “Customer Replied” runs on every reply, so “Add or Replace Text In Tab” may overwrite earlier text in that tab.
